name: cadenceux-developer-experience
description: The developer experience for agentic Claris FileMaker work, with or without Claris's Agentic Development Kit (ADK): directs the Developer, as Orchestrator, and the Agent through agile sprints (needs analysis, sprint planning, solution design, implementation, QA testing, review and optimise, deploy), with the thinking hats each stage calls and the gates work must pass before it deploys; routes each task to the skill or ADK tool that owns it, checks the stack is current, and guides the decisions around the code (native or web viewer, data access, FileMaker 26.0.3 and earlier, reviews, linter tests, security and deployment). Replaces cadenceux-dx.
